name: io.github.pete-builds/mcp-searxng
title: SearXNG Search
description: Self-hosted web research for AI agents over your own SearXNG. No paid search API.

environmentVariables.name: SEARXNG_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of your SearXNG instance, with the JSON format enabled (e.g. http://host.docker.internal:8888)

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Must be stdio when a client launches the container directly
